comments.author: @travelintolifeus
comments.text: Living in Norway must require a different kind of strength, especially when daylight disappears for so much of the winter. I'm impressed by how people adapt their routines, stay connected to nature, and find happiness even during the darkest months. That's real resilience.

comments.author: @edgeatlas4k
comments.text: That dialogue intro with the couple and the moving boxes caught me off guard - a different approach for this niche. The aerial shots over the Norwegian suburbs right after really sell how orderly everyday life looks there.
